title: Dropbox synced folder
whyItMatters: Dropbox keeps a local copy of synced files in the user profile. Those copies can contain private documents even after the account is signed out.
source: Dropbox Help, change the Dropbox folder location: the default on Windows is %HOMEPATH%/Dropbox - https://help.dropbox.com/installs/dropbox-folder-location
notes: The glob also matches Dropbox (Personal) and Dropbox (Team) folders. Online-only placeholders are counted, not hydrated. A custom folder location is not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any file you need that exists only in the local Dropbox folder to a drive you keep.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Dropbox in the app, then remove this computer from the account's connected devices on the Dropbox website.
steps: Confirm the files you need are copied somewhere safe.
Quit Dropbox from the notification area.
Unlink this computer in the Dropbox settings.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Recycle Bin.
cleanup.risk: Local copies leave this PC. Files still in the Dropbox account are untouched, and online-only files were never here.
cleanup.source: Dropbox Help, Sign in and sign out of Dropbox: https://help.dropbox.com/account-access/sign-in-out
